newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:
Spokesman Filippo di Robilant briefed on Thursday's Consumer Council held in Luxembourg and on next Monday and Tuesday's Fisheries Council.

Di Robilant said Commissioner Emma Bonino would meet representatives of consumers associations on Saturday from 1000/0800 GMT to 1300/1100 GMT at the Borschette Centre. He said she would meet the agricultural and agro-industrial representatives in the afternoon.
Spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said Commissioner Manuel Marin had underlined the political and diplomatic role of the EU in the Middle East peace process on Thursday.
In answer to a question, spokesman Peter Guilford said that it is the Common Foreign Security Policy's (CFSP) role to decide eventual sanctions on Iran, not the Trade Commissioner's.

Coll i Carbo said the Commission showed solidarity with Thursday's CFSP declaration on Iran. He also said that since there were no day-to-day relations between the Commission and Iran, the declaration would not bring any change.
Guilford said the negotiations on the Helms-Burton and d'Amato bills with the United States were continuing but that it was too soon to speak of an agreement because major obstacles remained.
Spokesman Gerry Kiely said the EU/U.S. negotiations on meat standards had been extended for one more day.

Spokeswoman Barbara Nolan denied any link between the working time directive, the white paper on the sectors excluded from the directive and the UK general elections. She also said there was no question of delaying the white paper after the end of June 1997 because of the UK elections.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/289: The European Union and the Republic of Korea sign a customs cooperation and a mutual assistance agreement.
- IP/97/290: The European Union and Norway sign an agreement on customs cooperation.
- IP/97/292: Agreement with Belgacom on the publication of telephone directories - ITT withdraws its complaint.
- Speech/97/78: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn at a conference at the University of Uppsala.
- Speech/97/80: Speech by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis on "The European-Asean roundtable on energy".
- Memo/97/40: XXIIIrd annual general assembly of European development NGOs - Bruxelles 11-12 April 1997.
- Memo/97/41: Calendar of the commissioners activities for the week of April 14-19, 1997.
- European Social Fund Info review No 1/February 1997.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Energy and industry No 1997-4: Producer price indices of industrial production.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - ECU-EMS information & central bank interest rates No 1997-3.
- ME97/11.4: Midday Express.
